SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Terry Kistler, Chair
Scott Snider, Vice Chair  Jenny Jolly, Committee Member
George Borst, Committee Member  Mary Smith, Committee Member
Edward Padgett, Committee Member  Bette Donovan Committee Member

  Wednesday, August 19, 2026
  Regular Meeting at 10:00 AM
  La Verne Community Center
  3680 D Street, La Verne, CA 91750
Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Senior Advisory Committee meetings are
welcomed and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Committee with valuable
information. In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City
Clerk’s Office at (909) 596-8726 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Persons addressing the Senior Advisory Committee shall be limited to 3 minutes unless an extension
of time is granted by the Chair, subject to approval of the Committee Members. When any group of
persons wishes to address the Committee, it shall be proper for the Chair to request that a
spokesperson be chosen to represent the group.

Public comments will be allowed on items on this Agenda at the time each item is considered.

Mission of the Senior Advisory Committee
To plan for coordinated delivery of services to senior citizens to eliminate duplication and conflict of
effort, as well as to inform its seniors of the availability of programs.

CALL TO ORDER AND PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

PRESENTATIONS

1.  Isela Moreno, MHSA Program Supervisor, Community Navigator, Daniel Rojos,
  Community Navigator, Tri-City Mental Health.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

2.  Wednesday, June 17, 2026

DISCUSSION ITEMS

3.
  a. Senior Nutrition Program
  b. Meals on Wheels Program
 AGENDA  Senior Citizen Advisory Committee 8/19/2026  Page 2

  c. Bingo Report
  d. Account Balance Update
  e. Monthly Senior Program Fees
  f. Mt. SAC Classes Update
  g. AgingNext
  h. Facilities Report
  i. Upcoming Events

PUBLIC COMMENT
Public comments will be allowed on items not on the Agenda but within the subject matter jurisdiction
of the Committee; however, no action may be taken on off-agenda items except as provided by law.

STAFF/COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION & INFORMATION
Committee members may ask a question for clarification, make a brief announcement, make a brief
report on his/her own activities, request staff to report back at a subsequent meeting concerning any
matter, or take action to direct staff to place a matter of business on a future agenda.

ADJOURNMENT

The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Senior Advisory Committee will be held at
  10:00 AM on September 16, 2026 at the La Verne Community Center.

Posting Statement: A true copy of this Agenda was posted on Wednesday, August 12, 2026,
on the bulletin board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s website
at www.laverneca.gov
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, August 19, 2026

  ACTION MINUTES
  “See items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at:
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, August 19, 2026.

  Members present: Jenny Jolly, Mary Smith, George Borst, Scott Snider, Bette
  Donovan.

  Members Absent: Terry Kistler, Edward Padgett.

  Staff Present: Armando Cisneros, Parks & Recreation Specialist, Robyn
  Olsen, Parks & Recreation Specialist.

  It was moved by George Borst and seconded by Mary Smith to approve the
  minutes of Wednesday, June 17, 2026 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: Isela Moreno, MHSA Program Supervisor, Community Navigator,
  Daniel Rojos, Community Navigator, Tri-City Mental Health. Tri-City serves the
  communities of Pomona, Claremont and La Verne. Daniel spoke about the
  various services offered, including the Mobile Crisis Care available 24/7. Many
  issues addressed in our community include unhoused individuals, financial and
  food insecurity, as well as connecting older adults with senior resources. When
  asked what they see as the most pressing issues they said they see seniors on
  fixed incomes that are going to become unhoused because they can’t afford
  their rents.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: 588 meals were served to an average of 27 participants in
  June. 569 meals were served in July to an average of 27 participants.

  Meals on Wheels: Total number of La Verne residents served for the month of
  June 2026 was 540.

4. Bingo Report: Receipts for June 2026 totaled $12,200.00 (rent to City of La
  Verne $400.00; Miscellaneous $100.00; Payouts $11,700.00). Attendance over
  4 dates was 400 participants.

5. Account Balance: N/A.
 6. Senior Program Fees: All program fees are paid.

7. MT. SAC Classes: Mt. Sac is currently on summer break. Fall session will begin on
  Monday, August 24th.

8. Aging Next: Total number of La Verne residents served for the month of June
  2026 was 7. Total number of La Verne residents served for the month of July
  2026 was 4.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: The Senior Craft Room is being remodeled due to the water
  leaks.

10. Upcoming Events

  •  Friday, August 21st– Excursion: A Day in Laguna Beach, 8:30AM – 4:00PM.
  •  Wednesday, August 26th – Senior Seminar: Late Life Transitions, Presented by Los Angeles County
  Department of Mental Health, 10:45AM.
  •  Wednesday, September 2nd – Senior Seminar: Goals for a Healthier You, Presented by the YWCA,
  10:30AM.
  •  Wednesday, September 9th – Senior Seminar: Are you Financially Prepared for a Longer Life?
  Presented by Live Better Financial, 10:30AM.
  •  Thursday, September 10th– Excursions: Ronald Reagan Presidential Library & Museum Featuring
  America, 8:15AM – 5:00PM.
  •  Monday, September 14th – Movie Matinee: Father of the Bride, 12:30PM.
  •  Tuesday, September 22nd – Health and Resource Fair, 9:00AM – 11:30AM.

  Public Comments: Armando shared that he and Robyn have begun working on
  bylaws for the Senior Advisory Committee. A draft should be available soon. It
  was announced that the new recreational guide is out.

  Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 10:48AM. The next meeting will be held on
  Wednesday, September 16, 2026 at 10:00AM.

  Submitted by:
  Armando Cisneros
  Parks & Recreation Specialist
